Subject: Legal routing & stakeholders for pilot - Acme Health

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to meet earlier — quick recap from our discovery and the asks we agreed on: 

1) Stakeholders we need to map:
   - Economic buyer / decision approver (who signs the PO)
   - Legal owner(s) for NDA and MSA (name/email)
   - Security / privacy owner for DPA questions
   - Procurement owner who will handle PO and payment terms

2) Docs and routing sequence we recommend: NDA (get started immediately) -> MSA + DPA (concurrent, MSA typically redlines) -> PO.

3) Turn-time expectations: please let us know your typical SLA for NDA turnaround and MSA redline cycles. Our experience: NDA can be completed in 1-3 business days, MSA 1-3 rounds over 2-4 weeks depending on complexity. We'll prioritize quicker paths (e.g., mutual NDA + pilot SOW) if procurement prefers.

Attachments: pilot_scope.pdf (attached) — includes proposed pilot SOW and data handling summary.

As next steps: could you reply with the names/emails for the people above and any internal process notes (e.g., panel review, required SOC reports)? Once we have the legal contact we can send an initial NDA (DocuSign) and flag the MSA + DPA for routing.

Thanks —
Marissa
Customer Success / Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the SOW. Quick answers below: 

- Economic buyer: Michael Grant (VP Product) — michael.grant@acmehealth.com (he will sign the PO).
- Procurement owner: Tom Rivera (cc'd) — handles PO & payment terms; typical PO lead time ~2 weeks after contract is finalized.
- Legal owner: Laura Chen (cc'd) — in-house counsel owns NDAs/MSAs.
- Security/privacy: Rachel Kim (security@acmehealth.com) — handles data classification and DPA questions.

On turn times here: procurement/legal want to see NDA first. NDA usually signed within 3-5 business days (we have an internal review queue). MSA tends to go through 2 rounds of redlines and can take 3-5 weeks depending on dependencies. If we can do a mutual NDA + a short pilot addendum it speeds things up.

We'll start the internal kick-off tomorrow and will confirm owners via our procurement portal. Please send the NDA doc via DocuSign to Laura and Tom.

Best,
Samantha
Senior Product Manager, Acme Health
Samantha.Lee@acmehealth.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Legal routing & stakeholders for pilot - Acme Health

Thanks for the ping. Plan / recommendations: 

1) NDA first: we can prepare a mutual NDA and get it routed via DocuSign. Turn time: internal review 1 business day, then send to counterparty. Expect signing within 1-3 business days once sent.

2) MSA + DPA sequencing: we should route the MSA after NDA is signed. We'll accept parallel review of the DPA (privacy) — many customers prefer DPA redlines to run concurrently with MSA. Estimated internal turnaround: initial redlines within 5-7 business days for a standard MSA. If Acme provides a redlined MSA, we'll aim for faster acknowledgement and point-by-point responses within 3 business days.

3) Redline strategy: suggest we send a cover email with our preferred positions and a short "redline playbook" to reduce back-and-forth (attached). If procurement is time-constrained, we can offer a pilot addendum with limited indemnity and liability caps for the pilot period to shorten approval time.

4) Attachments: I created a quick instructions file (MSA_Acme_redline_instructions.txt) with our common concessions and non-starters — attach this with the NDA envelope. Also include the pilot_scope.pdf as SOW.

Marissa: please confirm the DocuSign recipients and whether Acme prefers the NDA from their template or ours. If they have an NDA they want us to sign, send it over and we'll review.

Priya: will coordinate on DPA elements (Rachel is the contact). Priya, can you list the three core asks we should pre-populate?

- Dev

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>

Hi all — quick update from procurement/legal side:

- Procurement will kick off the NDA via our DocuSign template on Monday (Tom to send envelope).
- Laura (legal) has asked for Redwood to provide the pilot SOW + a short note on indemnity/liability for pilot only.
- Rachel (security) will share our DPA baseline later today; she prefers we review and mark any deviations.

Tom, please include Marissa and Dev on the DocuSign envelope so they can track signing. Once NDA is signed we will open the MSA review queue — target to complete initial redlines within 2 weeks but this may slip depending on other priorities.

Thanks everyone — look forward to getting the NDA in place.

Samantha
